summary:
TERRA AI – Responsible Global Planetary Analog Discovery that is developed by Team Blmites as part of the NASA hackathon 2026. This tool helps to identify the Earth locations, which are analogous to the factors present in other planets like Mars and Moon. Since it is expensive and hard to do experimentation in other planets, the presence of an analog gives us the ability to get access to the location quickly and conduct experimentation on the equipment and gain insight about planetary exploration.
This project involves a large set of factors including landform, imagery, climate, geology and hydrology. Using feature matching and similarity score, we will be able to identify the best places to explore. The Environmental Responsibility Score has been included by us which takes into account the factors involved regarding disruption of the environment, pollution and degradation of environment. This score also helps us to be systematic and thoughtful while searching for analogs of the planets.
details:
TERRA AI is an AI project designed by Team Blmites to find analogues on Earth to specific areas on the Martian/Lunar surface. We collect and process environmental data so that features can be extracted for comparison using cosine similarity. We have introduced an Environmental Responsibility Score (ERS), which gives us insight into how environmentally responsible the area is. This considers how disruptive it would be to the environment, pollution and land degradation. We can then determine good analogues based on how similar and environmentally responsible they are.

We will be able to help with planetary research by easily finding areas on Earth to experiment, test equipment and study the environment without spending large amounts of money on extraterrestrial environments. The aim of this project is to help responsibly explore planets using data. This project has a creative element to it as we are using AI to find analogues however we are considering how environmentally responsible they are. We have considered many factors such as terrain, images, climate, geological features, water indicators and environmental risks. This could be done by using Python, machine learning libraries, geographical data sets, satellite images, VS code And Github code space.
